purpose: out-of-fold member predictions on a cohort no member was fitted on, so stacking weights are not fitted on in-sample predictions

inner_split_info.limitation: train contains only 5 strains, so the novel-strain axis can be probed one strain at a time; the strain_novel dev set is a single-strain estimate and its selection signal is noisier than the chemical one

caveat: inner_fit has ~2378 rows vs ~5078 for the full train split, so inner members are weaker than the final members; weights calibrated here are biased toward the analytic baseline, i.e. conservative rather than optimistic
